topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, the tumor microenvironment, and the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive Darwinian clonal selection in tissues.

topics.label: Stem cell biology and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine normal stem cell hierarchies and present experimental evidence for cancer stem cells and cell-of-origin dynamics across different cancer types.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment, inflammation, and stroma in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how external inflammatory signals, microenvironmental promotion, and stromal interactions permit and sustain neoplastic growth.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for investigating tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes modern sequencing technologies, spatial omics, and computational modeling used to map evolutionary trajectories in cancer.

topics.label: Synthesis of multi-factorial cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive framework of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the presentation and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
